Changelog:
v1.0.4.309 (2026-10-17)

v1.0.4.308 (2026-10-15) [testing]
- Telemetry only, no behaviour change: the Crucible decision log line (CR|) now carries the inputs the offline replay could not rebuild from the rest of the line - the target's invulnerability flag, the readiness of the Beastmaster's long cooldowns (the three horns, Shield Charge, Rally, Cheer, Beast Mode and the rest) as a bitmap, the health potion count, the player's current and maximum health, GCD and weave readiness, the in-combat and casting state, and whether Morphos or other enemies are still up. The offline replay tool reads these fields and replays the Crucible hold rules from them, so more of a recorded fight can be replayed faithfully.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.307 (2026-10-15) [testing]
- **Beastmaster in the Crucible of the Unbroken, King Ahriman Piece: the Final Hourglass is no longer broken at the moment that points the Death cone at the character.** Breaking the hourglass makes the needle fire Death, a 23-yard cone along the needle's heading at its next tick, and Death puts Doom on whatever stands in it: a 6-second countdown that ends in certain death and that no cleanse, dispel or item removes. The needle ticks every 1.56 seconds and turns a quarter turn after each tick, and the character stands bound beside the hourglass, so a break lands in the cone about one time in four. The recorded runs show it: Death hit the character in 6 of 12 roulettes and every Doom ended in death. The rotation used to break the hourglass as fast as possible whatever the needle did. Now, once the hourglass is low enough for a single hit to break it (75% of its health or less), the weaponskill is held whenever a needle tick that the break could precede points at the character, and goes out the moment none does; the needle points at the character a quarter of the time, so the wait is at most one turn of the needle (about 6 seconds). The hold gives up 12 seconds after the hourglass appears, and does nothing at all when the needle cannot be read, which leaves the previous behaviour.
- **The log records every turn of the needle (`NE|` lines: the needle's heading, the hourglass's health, the hourglass's age, and the character's bearing and distance from the needle).**
- Doom itself cannot be removed. The game marks the Crucible's Doom as not cleansable ("Certain death when counter reaches zero"): no beast action (Ultrasonics, Scouring Ash, Quelling Wave) and no Crucible item removes it, so the cleanse path correctly stays idle. Its Crucible sources are Mortal Ray and the Ahriman gaze (Taurus Piece; the lit floor tiles clear it), the Dirty Eye's Mortal Gaze (looking away avoids it) and the King Ahriman Piece's Death (fixed here); Soulreaper's Armor is the only item that resists Doom.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.306 (2026-10-15) [testing]
- **White Mage: Temperance and Divine Caress are now handled as the two separate actions they are.** Since the pair was split, the heal combos watched for the Divine Grace buff and pressed whatever Temperance had turned into. Now Temperance itself is used when it is ready - in the single-target, area and simple heal modes and in the raidwide features alike - and Divine Caress is pressed on its own when it is ready. The area-of-effect simple heal mode gains a Divine Caress step it did not have, and the Asylum replacement mode now tries Asylum first, then Temperance, then Divine Caress, instead of preferring Temperance while Asylum was on cooldown.
- **A ground-placed action is no longer fired before it is ready.** The action watcher could send a ground-target placement for a replacement action that was still on cooldown; it now checks readiness first.
- Merges upstream WrathCombo changes through 2026-10-14 (9 commits). The automatic regen and shield checks on the focus target now use the plugin's own status lookup, ending an ambiguity with the shared library's lookup of the same name.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.305 (2026-10-15) [testing]
- **Beastmaster in the Crucible of the Unbroken, Abaddon Piece: the rotation no longer stands idle while a Morpho is alive.** The Abaddon was held back from the start of the fight until every Morpho was gone, and the Morphos themselves are never attacked, so for as long as a Morpho lived (over a minute in a recorded fight) the Abaddon was the only enemy and nothing was left that the rotation was allowed to hit: no damage and no aggro while the Morphos confused the character. Intended behaviour in this piece: the Drake and the Barbmoles are killed first, as before; once the Abaddon is the only enemy left it is attacked and chipped down to 35% of its health, and held there while any Morpho is alive, so it is never killed ahead of the Morphos it feeds on; once the last Morpho is gone it is attacked to the end. Eggs and Morphos as targets are still never attacked, and the Gigantis gel rule is unchanged.
- The Abaddon's Regen (Rehabilitation, one minute, renewed each time it eats a Morpho) is deliberately not dispelled: Quelling Wave never removed it in the recorded casts (15 casts on the Abaddon, the buff always ran its full minute), so the rotation does not spend casts on it. The Drake's Blaze Spikes are still dispelled.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.304 (2026-10-14) [testing]
- **While another plugin controls the rotation, a training dummy that is the chosen target is left alone too.** The Manual mode, the manual area-of-effect aim and the Tank Target mode take their target from a selected target - the character's own, or in Tank Target mode the tank's - instead of from the enemy filter that 1.0.4.303 added, so a Striking Dummy that was already selected could still be struck while a lease was held. The same dummy check now covers that path: while another plugin is in control or still holds a lease, the dummy is not attacked even as the chosen target; without a lease the player's own choice stands.
- The external-control check reads the lease table directly on every tick instead of building a list for each read (the rotation consults it several times a tick).
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.
